content:
- Do not go with them, even if they know your name or your dad’s name, or say there’s an emergency.
- Say: “I’m not allowed to go with anyone unless my parent/guardian told me first.” 
- Go to a safe adult right away—teacher, coach, school office, crossing guard—and tell them what happened.
- Ask the school to call your parent/guardian to verify. Only leave with someone your parent/guardian or the school confirms.
- Use your family “password” if you have one. If they don’t know it, do not go.
- Stay with friends or in a public, supervised area; never walk to a car or a secluded spot.
- If the person pressures you, yell for help (“This isn’t my parent! I need help!”) and go back inside the school or to a crowded place. Call 911 if you feel in danger.
- Remember details (what they look like, car color/plate) and share them with a trusted adult.

Tip for families: Set a pickup plan and a shared password; tell the school who is allowed to pick you up.
